goals.title: No live page still framed around a sale that has ended
goals.description: Published articles still tagged holiday:<id> for a retail sale that ended in the last 60 days. Each one tells readers and AI assistants to buy in a sale that is over. The refresh replaces the tag, so this falls to 0 as refreshes ship. Emitted key: ended_event_articles_live.
directives: If this stays above 0 for more than 3 days after an event ends, check recs_requeued and refresh_attempts_exhausted; deferred article-refresh recs (required-model-unavailable) are re-queued daily up to max_attempts, so exhausted ones need the claude-pool fixed and say so in the run summary
Re-queue an article the ledger holds only while it still carries the ended event tag, after retry_after_hours, under max_attempts, with no pending auto-queue file and no defer_backoff cooldown

goals.title: Every tagged article queued for refresh the day after its sale ends
goals.description: Articles tagged with a sale that ended within the lookback window but not yet queued (cap overflow, dry run, queue failure). Target 0 on the first run after the end date. Emitted key: unqueued_ended_event_articles.
directives: Queue one article-refresh rec per tagged article, Opus required, on the first run after the event's last day
When the per-site cap overflows, raise max_recs_per_site in config/event-refresh-config.json rather than dropping pages

goals.title: Zero site read or queue failures
goals.description: A site whose article select or queue write failed gets no refresh that day. Emitted key: site_errors.
directives: Name the failing site and the error in the decision log; the next run retries it
